arena.onSelectMessage:
{Arena}

You approach a roaring arena, where a pack of vicious lions awaits any challenger.  The aged trainer of gladiators nods toward the gate and says he will offer to train you in a skill of your choice if you survive.
arena.onVisitedMessage:
{Arena}

The Arena guards prevent you from entering.  "You've already beaten our best.  Begone from here."

modify@1.message:
{Witch's Hut}

An ancient witch living in a strange hut welcomes you and offers to teach you %s for her own inscrutable purposes.

{Scholar}

As you ride into a clearing, you notice a university scholar resting his horse.  He offers to teach you some of what he knows before setting off.
